scope: Finite numerical quadrature and SciPy special-function fixtures; not a universal accuracy or discretization-order certificate.

green.sourceDefinition: q=(x/R)^a*(y/R)^b on the upper half disk; q=0 outside; -Delta psi=q; u1=-psi_y, u2=psi_x
green.referenceDefinition: Half-plane image Green integral: psi=integral q*log(Dplus/Dminus)/(4*pi), Dplus=(x-X)^2+(y+Y)^2, Dminus=(x-X)^2+(y-Y)^2.

quadrature.sourceCoordinates: Rays centered at the evaluation point; upper-unit-disk ray lengths from circle/wall intersections.
quadrature.directLogTerm: Radial integral of each polynomial times t*log(t) evaluated analytically.
quadrature.imageAndVelocityRadialRule: 96-point Gauss-Legendre; point-centered coordinates cancel the direct velocity singularity.
quadrature.angleRule: SciPy integrate.quad_vec, split at ray-domain boundary changes, epsabs=2e-12, epsrel=2e-12, limit=300

provenance.generator: verify_independent.py direct_green_all; fixture constructed without calling the MATLAB analytic Green implementation.
